description: This file defines the class ExpandableList1, an Android activity demonstrating the use of expandable lists with a custom adapter. It includes methods for setting up the adapter, handling context menus, and managing expandable list items. It also contains an inner class MyExpandableListAdapter that provides the data and view logic for the expandable list.

classes.name: ExpandableList1
classes.description: Main activity class that demonstrates expandable list usage with context menu handling.

classes.name: MyExpandableListAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseExpandableListAdapter, providing data and views for the expandable list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the adapter, and registers the context menu.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu with a sample action.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles context menu item selections, showing a toast based on whether a group or child is clicked.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns the child item at the specified group and child position.

methods.name: getChildId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the specified child.

methods.name: getChildrenCount
methods.description: Returns the number of children in a specified group.

methods.name: getGenericView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TextView for use as a list item.

methods.name: getChildView
methods.description: Provides the view for a child item in the list.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group item at the specified position.

methods.name: getGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of groups.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID for a group.

methods.name: getGroupView
methods.description: Provides the view for a group item.

methods.name: isChildSelectable
methods.description: Indicates whether a child is selectable.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether the IDs are stable.
